summary: Intapp, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a new $150 million senior secured revolving credit facility with UBS AG as Administrative Agent, replacing a prior credit agreement. The facility matures in five years, includes a $10 million letter of credit subfacility and an accordion feature up to $75 million. Pricing is SOFR-based plus 1.50%-2.25% or base rate plus 0.50%-1.25%, tied to leverage. Proceeds are for working capital and general corporate purposes. This is a routine refinancing of corporate credit lines, not a special situation. No equity or structural event is involved.
